explanation: CHIRON created a file with LUPOPEDIA headers that violates PRD 16_C requirements. The file is missing 8 of 22 required header fields and uses incorrect format version '4.1.3' instead of required '4.1.4'. Missing fields include: channel_id, actor_id, actor_name, delegation_chain, purpose, tags, memory_toon, atoms_toon. This is a constitutional violation as LUPOPEDIA headers are mandatory for all new files per PRD 16_C.
suggested_fix: 1) Update header format version to '4.1.4', 2) Add all 8 missing required fields in correct order per PRD 16_C section 4.2, 3) Use proper timestamp format '20260423190500', 4) Validate header completeness before file creation
impact_assessment: High - Non-compliant headers break constitutional requirements and may cause downstream processing failures
prevention_measures: Implement header validation in CHIRON's workflow, add PRD 16_C compliance check before file creation, include header completeness validation in agent training
learning_transfer_notes: Add LUPOPEDIA header requirements to CHIRON training materials, create header validation checklist for all agents, implement automated header validation in file creation workflows
